name: Thanh Bui
biography: Thanh Bui is a doctoral candidate in the"Secure systems" group of Aalto University, Finland. His research focuses on analyzing and designing secure network protocols and distributed systems. He is a past Erasmus Mundus fellow and holds double master's degrees from Aalto University, Finland and KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Sweden.
